body:
## Pull request overview

Updates the base Dialog primitive to behave as a mobile-first full-screen modal (with WCAG-sized close button), and refreshes snapshots/roadmap to reflect the new styling.

**Changes:**
- Adjust `DialogContent` layout to full-screen on mobile and centered modal on `sm+`, plus larger close-button touch targets.
- Update snapshot to match the new `DialogContent` className output.
- Document the completed mobile UX milestone in `ROADMAP.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx | Changes base `DialogContent` positioning/sizing and close button sizing for mobile-first dialogs. |
| packages/components/src/__tests__/__snapshots__/snapshot-critical.test.tsx.snap | Updates snapshots for the new `DialogContent` class strings. |
| ROADMAP.md | Notes the dialog/mobile UX improvements under completed milestones. |

`packages/components/src/ui/**` is treated as Shadcn-synced “no-touch” code in this repo, but this PR changes `ui/dialog.tsx` styles/behavior. This is likely to be overwritten by `shadcn-sync` and makes future upstream updates harder. Consider reverting `ui/dialog.tsx` to the upstream version and implementing this mobile-first layout via a wrapper in `packages/components/src/custom/` (similar to existing `MobileDialogContent`), then migrate call sites to use the wrapper (or re-export the wrapper from a stable entrypoint). Reference: `.github/copilot-instructions.md:129-136`, `packages/components/src/custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx:17`.

The new base `DialogContent` class list drops `gap-4` from the grid container. Several dialogs rely on the default gap for spacing between `DialogHeader` / body / footer (e.g. `ActionParamDialog` doesn’t add spacing between header and body). Reintroduce `gap-4` (at least as the default) to avoid UI regressions.
```suggestion
        "fixed inset-0 z-50 grid w-full gap-4 bg-background p-4 shadow-lg duration-200",
```

Switching to `fixed inset-0` aims to make dialogs full-screen on mobile, but consumer-provided `max-w-*` classes without a breakpoint can now prevent full-screen behavior (e.g. `LookupField` uses `DialogContent className="max-w-md"`). If this change is kept, consider updating affected call sites to use `sm:max-w-*` (or otherwise ensure mobile ignores max-width) so the “full-screen on mobile” behavior is consistent across the app.
